Short answers to both questions, then the routing.

(1) Item ids today: the page tools (Servex/agents/page_tools.js) use the id the caller passes; if there is none, they make a random UUID (crypto.randomUUID). There is no short-id counter like "c2". A set or update finds the item by its top-level id and does a SHALLOW merge (old fields, then the new fields on top). So deltas work one level deep only: a nested key is not followed into a sub-item, and changing a nested field replaces that whole field. "Deep deltas, a nested id walks into the item" would be new work.

(2) Page.clone / templates: yes, partly. core/Page/Template/Template.js has a clone(data) method built with Object.create(this), so a clone inherits from its template and keeps a list of its clones. It is a Template class (BigCard is the example), not a Page.clone on Page itself, and nothing yet lets a child page use its parent as a template.
